A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NCS is a redox-active chromophore that can be activated by one electron donors to produce a reactive species able to induce DNA strand breakage.
CO-2, an oxygen radical, is able to activate NCS in the absence of oxygen and to induce DNA strand cleavage.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CO-2 radical is a useful reagent to investigate the redox chemistry of the NCS antibiotic and its interaction with DNA.
